# `<sl-icon-button>` — Icon Button

> **Customized in Saipem DS.** It differs from upstream Shoelace: new attribute `variant` ('default' | 'primary' | 'accent' | 'success' | 'neutral' | 'warning' | 'danger'); new attribute `size` ('small' | 'large' | 'x-large'); new attribute `filled`. Use only the API below.

Icons buttons are simple, icon-only buttons that can be used for actions and in toolbars.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon-button/icon-button.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | The name of the icon to draw. Available names depend on the icon library being used. |
| `library` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | The name of a registered custom icon library. |
| `src` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | An external URL of an SVG file. Be sure you trust the content you are including, as it will be executed as code and can result in XSS attacks. |
| `href` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | When set, the underlying button will be rendered as an `<a>` with this `href` instead of a `<button>`. |
| `target` | — | `_blank`, `_parent`, `_self`, `_top` | — | Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is set. |
| `download` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | Tells the browser to download the linked file as this filename. Only used when `href` is set. |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | A description that gets read by assistive devices. For optimal accessibility, you should always include a label that describes what the icon button does. |
| `variant` | — | `default`, `primary`, `accent`, `success`, `neutral`, `warning`, `danger` | `'default'` | The icon button's theme variant. `default` keeps the plain ghost style used throughout the app. |
| `size` | — | `small`, `large`, `x-large` | — | The icon button's size, from the theme tokens `--sl-icon-button-font-size-*` (and `--sl-icon-button-padding-small`). Without a size, the icon inherits the surrounding font size, as before. Use `small` for row actions in tables. |
| `filled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the icon button with a solid background instead of the soft, pale variant background. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-blur` | — | Emitted when the icon button loses focus. |
| `sl-focus` | — | Emitted when the icon button gains focus. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `click()` | Simulates a click on the icon button. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Sets focus on the icon button. |
| `blur()` | Removes focus from the icon button. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |

## Documentation and examples

For a full list of icons that come bundled with Shoelace, refer to the [icon component](icon.md).

```html
<sl-icon-button name="gear" label="Settings"></sl-icon-button>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon-button/icon-button.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-icon-button-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-icon-button name="gear" label="Settings"></sl-icon-button>`
})
export class IconButtonExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Sizes

Set `size` to `small`, `large` or `x-large`; the values come from the theme tokens `--sl-icon-button-font-size-*` and
`--sl-icon-button-padding-small`. Use `small` for row actions in tables. Without `size` (the Figma `medium` size), the `default` icon button
inherits its parent element's `font-size` and the coloured variants keep their standalone toolbar size.

```html
<sl-icon-button name="info-circle" label="Document info" variant="neutral" size="small"></sl-icon-button>
<sl-icon-button name="info-circle" label="Document info" variant="neutral"></sl-icon-button>
<sl-icon-button name="info-circle" label="Document info" variant="neutral" size="large"></sl-icon-button>
<sl-icon-button name="info-circle" label="Document info" variant="neutral" size="x-large"></sl-icon-button>
```

A custom `font-size` still works for any other size.

```html
<sl-icon-button name="pencil" label="Edit" style="font-size: 1.5rem;"></sl-icon-button>
<sl-icon-button name="pencil" label="Edit" style="font-size: 2rem;"></sl-icon-button>
<sl-icon-button name="pencil" label="Edit" style="font-size: 2.5rem;"></sl-icon-button>
```

### Colors

Icon buttons are designed to have a uniform appearance, so their color is not inherited. However, you can still customize them by styling the `base` part.

```html
<div class="icon-button-color">
  <sl-icon-button name="type-bold" label="Bold"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="type-italic" label="Italic"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="type-underline" label="Underline"></sl-icon-button>
</div>

<style>
  .icon-button-color sl-icon-button::part(base) {
    color: #b00091;
  }

  .icon-button-color sl-icon-button::part(base):hover,
  .icon-button-color sl-icon-button::part(base):focus {
    color: #c913aa;
  }

  .icon-button-color sl-icon-button::part(base):active {
    color: #960077;
  }
</style>
```

### Variants

Use the `variant` attribute to give the icon button a semantic color with a soft, pale background. Add the `filled` attribute to use a solid background instead.

```html
<div style="display: flex; gap: var(--sl-spacing-x-small);">
  <sl-icon-button name="download" label="Download" variant="primary"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="upload" label="Upload" variant="neutral"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="arrow-counterclockwise" label="Undo" variant="danger"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="arrow-clockwise" label="Redo" variant="primary"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="check-lg" label="Approve" variant="accent" filled></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button name="check2-circle" label="Complete" variant="neutral"></sl-icon-button>
</div>
```

### Link Buttons

Use the `href` attribute to convert the button to a link.

```html
<sl-icon-button name="gear" label="Settings" href="https://example.com" target="_blank"></sl-icon-button>
```

### Icon Button with Tooltip

Wrap a tooltip around an icon button to provide contextual information to the user.

```html
<sl-tooltip content="Settings">
  <sl-icon-button name="gear" label="Settings"></sl-icon-button>
</sl-tooltip>
```

### Disabled

Use the `disabled` attribute to disable the icon button.

```html
<sl-icon-button name="gear" label="Settings" disabled></sl-icon-button>
```
